exercises.question: Mike enjoys ________ his coworkers on Monday mornings.
exercises.explanation: "Catch up with someone" is the correct phrasal verb structure requiring "with" + object.

exercises.question: The teacher asked the students ________ during the exam.
She is very interested in ________ abroad next year.
exercises.explanation: After the preposition "in," use a gerund ("studying").

exercises.question: He decided ________ a new career after retirement.
exercises.explanation: "Decide" is followed by an infinitive: "to pursue."

exercises.question: She avoided ________ difficult questions during the interview.
exercises.explanation: "Avoid" is always followed by a gerund.

exercises.question: ________ being tired, she continued to work until midnight.
exercises.explanation: "Despite" is followed by a noun/gerund phrase ("being tired"). "Although/Even though" require a full clause.

exercises.question: Jonathan chose City University because they have an excellent engineering program ________.
exercises.explanation: "To study at" is an infinitive of purpose explaining why he chose it.

exercises.question: She decided ________ a new course next semester.
I can't afford ________ a new phone right now.
They avoided ________ about the problem.
exercises.explanation: 'Avoid' is followed by a gerund (-ing form).

exercises.question: Please remember ________ the door when you leave.
exercises.explanation: 'Remember to do' means not to forget a future action.

exercises.question: I remember ________ that film when I was a child.
exercises.explanation: 'Remember doing' refers to a memory of a completed past action.

exercises.question: The teacher made the students ________ the exercise again.
exercises.explanation: After 'make + object', use the bare infinitive: made students do.

exercises.question: It took me a long time to get used to ________ on the left.
exercises.explanation: 'Get used to' is followed by a noun or gerund: driving.
